lines.label: eclipse
lines.maoEnglish:
So many things had happened.
Some were almost beyond belief, and my life had veered so violently between stillness and turmoil that it hardly seemed like one life at all.
Things that were ordinary, and things that had never been ordinary.
All of it felt like a dream.
Even the smallest event, when I looked back, rested upon a chain of accidents.
The days had repeated themselves with mind-numbing familiarity, yet no two had ever been the same.
If so.
Did that not mean each one had been irreplaceable—a moment that could never return?
